**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement sits at the **preferred** position for MINCOMMIT — there is no take-or-pay exposure to fix:

- **No minimum/shortfall language exists.** Searches for "minimum", "commit" and "shortfall" turn up nothing on point; the sole "commitment" hit (p0143) is the standard no-agency clause.
- **Fees are consumption/order-based.** § 11 requires only payment of the Fee Schedule fees for the licence and services actually taken, and § 2 charges extra fees only if we elect to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations — an option, not a floor.
- **Maintenance is a renewable one-year term** (p0065), not a multi-year committed spend.
- **We hold an unconditional 90-day termination right** (§ 17(b)), so even the perpetual-licence fee construct in § 17(a) creates no lock-in.
- The § 3 use restrictions are ordinary licence-scope limits (copying, sublicensing, reverse engineering) rather than volume caps functioning as a purchase commitment.

No fallback reliance and no walk-away exposure, so I did not redline anything.
